description: This file defines a custom report class for generating an XML report of stock locations and products in OpenERP/Odoo, including methods for processing location hierarchy and product quantities.

classes.name: report_custom
classes.description: A custom report class inheriting from report_rml, responsible for creating XML stock location reports.

methods.name: create_xml
methods.description: Generates an XML report of stock locations and products, including hierarchy processing.
